effects.name: Glow
effects.description: Bloom: the bright parts bleed soft light into their surroundings (three passes: bright-pass + blur, blur, add back).
whenToUse: sell a bright light source or neon

params.name: threshold
params.label: Threshold
params.description: Brightness above which a pixel starts to glow

params.name: radius
params.label: Radius
params.description: Spread of the glow as a fraction of the frame height

effects.name: Light Leak
effects.description: Procedural warm light leaking in from an edge, drifting with time (screen blend).

params.name: hue
params.label: Hue
params.description: Colour of the leak in degrees (25 orange, 0 red, 330 pink)

params.name: angle
params.label: Angle
params.description: Edge the light enters from, in degrees (180 left, 0 right, 90 top)

params.name: spread
params.label: Spread
params.description: How far into the frame it reaches

effects.name: Lens Flare
effects.description: A light source with a soft core, halo, anamorphic streak and a few ghost reflections along the line through the frame centre.
whenToUse: add a sun or lamp flare to a shot
draw the eye to a light source

params.name: position
params.label: Position
params.description: Where the light source sits in the frame

effects.name: God Rays
effects.description: Crepuscular rays: bright areas are smeared radially away from a light point.

params.name: reach
params.label: Reach
params.description: How far towards the light the smear travels

params.name: threshold
params.label: Threshold
params.description: Brightness above which a pixel casts rays

effects.name: Lens Distortion
effects.description: Barrel (positive) or pincushion (negative) lens distortion with a zoom to hide the corners.
whenToUse: bulge a subject in the middle

params.name: zoom
params.label: Zoom
params.description: Zoom into the result (barrel needs about 1.15 to hide the corners)

effects.name: Radial Blur
effects.description: Zoom blur: the picture streaks towards (or away from) a centre point.

effects.name: Directional Blur
effects.description: Motion-style blur along a direction.
whenToUse: motion smear on a moving subject

params.name: angle
params.label: Angle
params.description: Direction of the blur in degrees

params.name: reach
params.label: Length
params.description: Blur length as a fraction of the frame height

effects.name: Tilt Shift
effects.description: Keeps a band of the frame sharp and blurs above and below it, for a miniature look.
whenToUse: fake shallow depth of field on a landscape

params.name: focus
params.label: Focus
params.description: Position of the sharp band from the top of the frame

params.name: falloff
params.label: Falloff
params.description: How gradually the blur grows away from the band

params.name: maxblur
params.label: Max blur
params.description: Strongest blur radius as a fraction of the frame height

params.name: angle
params.label: Angle
params.description: Tilt of the band in degrees

effects.name: Sharpen
effects.description: Unsharp mask: adds back the difference between the picture and a soft copy.

params.name: radius
params.label: Radius
params.description: Width of the detail it acts on, in pixels

effects.name: Defocus
effects.description: Small disc blur with brighter highlights, like an out-of-focus lens (use gaussian_blur for large soft blurs).

effects.name: Film Grain
effects.description: Animated film grain, strongest in the mid-tones; changes every frame step, repeatable for the same time and seed.

params.name: seed
params.label: Seed
params.description: Different seeds give different grain patterns

effects.name: VHS
effects.description: Analog tape: per-line jitter, a drifting tracking band, chroma bleed and static.

params.name: amount
params.label: Distortion
params.description: Line jitter and the tracking band

params.name: seed
params.label: Seed
params.description: Changes the pattern of the jitter

effects.name: CRT
effects.description: Old tube monitor: screen curvature, scanlines, RGB phosphor mask and corner shading.

params.name: scanlines
params.label: Scanlines
params.description: Strength of the dark lines between scan rows

params.name: line_size
params.label: Line size
params.description: Height of one scan row in pixels

effects.name: Halftone
effects.description: Print-style dots whose size follows brightness; mono (coloured dots) or CMYK screens.

params.name: size
params.label: Dot spacing
params.description: Distance between dots as a fraction of the frame height

params.name: angle
params.label: Angle
params.description: Angle of the dot grid in degrees

params.name: cmyk
params.label: CMYK
params.description: Four-ink screens at print angles instead of one mono grid

effects.name: Posterize
effects.description: Reduces each colour channel to a few levels.

effects.name: Pixelate
effects.description: Mosaic of square blocks.
whenToUse: transition into/out of a pixel mosaic (animate size)

effects.name: Dither
effects.description: Ordered (Bayer 8x8) dithering down to a few levels per channel.

params.name: scale
params.label: Pixel size
params.description: Size of one dither cell in pixels

params.name: amount
params.label: Dither
params.description: Strength of the dither pattern (0 = plain banding)

effects.name: Mirror
effects.description: Mirrors one half of the picture onto the other (horizontal, vertical, both) or folds it radially into segments.

params.name: axis
params.label: Axis
params.description: Where the mirror line runs (radial folds around the centre)

params.name: offset
params.label: Offset
params.description: Moves the mirror line (radial: rotates the segments, in turns)

effects.name: Kaleidoscope
effects.description: Folds the picture into rotating mirrored wedges around a centre.
whenToUse: turn footage into a pattern (animate rotation)

params.name: rotation
params.label: Rotation
params.description: Rotation of the pattern in degrees

effects.name: Duotone
effects.description: Maps brightness onto a gradient between a shadow colour and a highlight colour.

effects.name: Invert
effects.description: Inverts the colours (a negative), judged perceptually.

effects.name: Threshold
effects.description: Pure black and white: every pixel goes to one or the other depending on its brightness.

params.name: level
params.label: Level
params.description: Brightness (perceptual) at which black turns to white

params.name: softness
params.label: Softness
params.description: Width of the transition (0 = hard edge, only pure black and white)

effects.name: Edge Detect
effects.description: Sobel edge lines over the picture, with an optional soft glow around the edges.

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.description: Mix of the edge image into the picture

effects.name: RGB Split Glitch
effects.description: Digital glitch: blocks of the picture slip sideways while red and blue separate. Repeatable for the same time and seed.
whenToUse: glitch hit on an impact or beat

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.description: How many blocks glitch and how far they slip

params.name: rate
params.label: Rate
params.description: How many times per second the pattern changes

params.name: seed
params.label: Seed
params.description: Different seeds give different glitch patterns

effects.name: Wave Warp
effects.description: Ripples the picture with a travelling sine wave.

params.name: amplitude
params.label: Amplitude
params.description: Wave height as a fraction of the frame height

params.name: angle
params.label: Direction
params.description: Direction the waves travel, in degrees

effects.name: Swirl
effects.description: Twists the picture around a centre point, strongest in the middle.

params.name: angle
params.label: Angle
params.description: Twist at the centre in degrees

params.name: radius
params.label: Radius
params.description: Size of the affected area (frame heights)

effects.name: Camera Shake
effects.description: Handheld shake: smooth deterministic noise moves and rotates the picture. Limited to the clip's own bounds (edges are mirrored or clamped, and a small crop hides them).
whenToUse: add life to a locked-off shot

params.name: rotation
params.label: Rotation
params.description: How much of the shake is rotation

params.name: crop
params.label: Crop
params.description: Zoom in to hide the edges

params.name: edges
params.label: Edges
params.description: What shows where the picture is shifted away from the border

params.name: seed
params.label: Seed
params.description: Different seeds give different shake paths

effects.name: Polygon Mask
effects.description: Show the clip only inside (or outside) a polygon of up to 8 points; feathered edge.

params.name: p0
params.label: Point 0
params.description: Polygon point 0 (normalised item coords, top-left origin)

params.name: invert
params.label: Invert
params.description: Show outside the polygon instead of inside
